# StaticFiles fails to serve index.html files

## Description

I'm encountering an issue with the `StaticFiles` class when trying to serve `index.html` files from directories. The server is failing to properly detect and serve these files.

When I navigate to a directory URL that contains an index.html file, I'm getting a 404 error instead of the expected index.html content. This happens even though the file definitely exists in the directory.

## Reproduction

I have a simple directory structure:

```
static/
  ├── css/
  │    └── style.css
  ├── index.html
  └── images/
       └── logo.png
```

And I'm mounting the static files like this:

```python
from starlette.applications import Starlette
from starlette.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from starlette.routing import Mount

app = Starlette(routes=[
    Mount('/static', app=StaticFiles(directory='static'), name='static')
])
```

When I navigate to `/static/` in my browser, I expect to see the content of `index.html`, but instead I get a 404 error.

The strange thing is that direct file access works fine - I can access `/static/index.html` directly, and other static files like `/static/css/style.css` work as expected. It's just the directory index functionality that's broken.

I'm using the latest version of Starlette. Any help would be appreciated!
